title: Issue-guided Read Input Registers quantity-seven analogue
purpose: Preserve the historically mentioned address 0, quantity 7 read shape as a safe valid 0x04 request.
expected_behavior: Server should parse a valid Read Input Registers request for seven registers starting at address 0 and return data or a legal exception.
constraints_preserved: length is 0006 for unit_id plus 5-byte PDU
request body is starting address followed by quantity
quantity is 0007 as a valid nonzero read size
issue_safety_notes: Uses the issue-adjacent valid read shape only; no malformed or crash-specific bytes are reused.
